title: Parsing a binary gate
statement: Given a function that constructs a gate from two natural-number indices and a Boolean list, attempt to decode two natural numbers successively from the list. If both decodings succeed, return the constructed gate together with the unused suffix; if either decoding fails, return no result.
hypotheses_covered: A constructor from two natural numbers to a gate
